# AgentBridge — guide for LLMs and AI coding assistants

> AgentBridge (`@jeonhui/agentbridge`, MIT, Node >= 20, ESM only) is a headless local runtime that
> lets a program drive AI agents — the Claude Code / Codex CLIs installed on the machine, or model
> APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, LiteLLM, Gemini) — through one interface: sessions in,
> events out, user-defined MCP tools, and a deny-by-default permission system. It ships NO UI;
> the host application renders everything from the event stream.

This file is self-contained: everything needed to integrate AgentBridge is below.

## Two ways to run it

1. **Daemon (any language)** — `npx @jeonhui/agentbridge-cli serve` prints
   `{"host":"127.0.0.1","port":...,"token":"ab_local_..."}`. Talk REST + WebSocket (surface below).
   `npx @jeonhui/agentbridge-cli agents` lists which agent CLIs are installed.
2. **Embedded (Node)** — `pnpm add @jeonhui/agentbridge`, import subpaths as needed.

Subpath exports: `@jeonhui/agentbridge` (core), `/claude`, `/codex`, `/api` (API providers),
`/mcp`, `/permission`, `/runtime`, `/sdk` (browser-safe client), `/mcp-server`, `/provider`
(adapter contract).

## Minimal working example

```typescript
import { AgentBridge } from "@jeonhui/agentbridge";
import { ClaudeProvider } from "@jeonhui/agentbridge/claude";

const agent = new AgentBridge();               // config optional, see "Config"
agent.registerProvider(new ClaudeProvider());  // requires the `claude` CLI, logged in
await agent.start();                           // ALWAYS before sessions.create

const session = await agent.sessions.create({ provider: "claude" });
session.on("message", (e) => process.stdout.write(e.content));
await session.send("Summarise this project in one sentence.");
await agent.stop();
```

Rules an integrator must know:
- `await agent.start()` before creating sessions (AB-5005 otherwise).
- `send()` resolves when the TURN COMPLETES, not when the message is accepted. Stream output via
  events; concurrent `send()`s on one session queue (serialize) by default.
- Everything the agent does arrives as events. There is no other output channel.

## Events

`session.on(type, handler)` (session-scoped) or `agent.on(type, handler)` (global). Every event
has `{ id, seq, sessionId, turnId?, timestamp }`; `seq` increases monotonically per session, so a
client can recover gaps after reconnect (`GET /sessions/:id/events?sinceSeq=`).

| type | payload highlights |
| --- | --- |
| `message` | `role, content, delta, done` — deltas APPEND, a full message (`delta:false`) REPLACES |
| `tool_call` | `callId, tool, toolId, arguments, source{type: mcp\|builtin\|system\|agent}` |
| `tool_result` / `tool_error` | `callId, ok, content` / `error{code,message,retryable}`, `durationMs` |
| `status` | session `status` + `previous` (`starting/ready/running/waiting/stopped/error`) |
| `permission_request` | `requestId, tool, toolId, arguments, permissions, expiresAt` — answer it! |
| `usage` | per-turn `model` (the model that ACTUALLY served), `inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens` |
| `mcp_status` | MCP server `state` transitions |
| `error` | `error{code,...}, fatal` |

Sessions accumulate usage: `session.info.usage = { inputTokens, outputTokens, turns }`, and
`session.info.model` is updated to the model the provider reports — the ground truth.

## Providers

CLI adapters (one process per turn; conversation continuity via the CLI's own resume):
- `new ClaudeProvider({ defaultModel? })` from `/claude` — verified end to end.
- `new CodexProvider({ defaultModel? })` from `/codex` — implemented; sandbox pinned least-privilege.

API providers from `/api` (no CLI needed; AgentBridge runs the agent loop and executes tool calls
through its own permission system):
- `new AnthropicProvider({ apiKey?|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, defaultModel: "claude-sonnet-4-5", maxTokens? })`
- `new OpenAICompatProvider({ baseUrl, apiKey?|OPENAI_API_KEY, id?, defaultModel? })` — one adapter
  for OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama (`http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`), vLLM, any compatible endpoint.
- `new LiteLLMProvider({ ... })` — defaults `http://127.0.0.1:4000/v1`, `LITELLM_API_KEY`.
- `new GeminiApiProvider({ apiKey?|GEMINI_API_KEY, defaultModel: "gemini-2.0-flash" })`

Shared API-provider options: `streaming` (SSE deltas; on by default except Gemini),
`retry: { maxRetries=2, baseDelayMs=500, maxDelayMs=10000 }` (429/5xx/network auto-retry,
`Retry-After` honored; other 4xx fail fast), `requestTimeoutMs`, `maxToolRounds` (default 8),
`headers`, and `history: new FileHistoryStore({ directory })` which turns `capabilities.resume`
on — the conversation then survives a process restart via `agent.sessions.resume(id)`.

`agent.providers.list()` → `{ id, name, available, version?, defaultModel?, reason? }[]`.
Custom adapter: implement `AgentProvider` from `/provider` (for APIs, extend `ApiProviderBase`
from `/api` and write only `detect()` + `complete()`).

## Sessions

```typescript
agent.sessions.create({
  provider, model?, systemPrompt?, mcp?: ["serverId"], permissionMode?: "ask"|"allow"|"deny",
  workingDirectory?, env?, title?, queueing?,            // or: { agent: "reviewer", ...overrides }
});
session.send(message, { attachments? });   // -> { turnId, queued }
session.setModel("haiku");                 // next turn; conversation context SURVIVES
session.tools();                           // tools this session can see
session.interrupt(); session.stop();
agent.sessions.resume(sessionId);          // after restart; CLI adapters + stored-history APIs
```

Attachments (images/documents): `{ type: "image"|"document", data: base64NoPrefix, mimeType, name? }`.
API providers map them to their wire formats (OpenAI dialect: images only). CLI adapters reject
them with AB-1005 — never silently dropped. Attachments replay on resume.

## Tools (MCP)

```typescript
import { McpManager } from "@jeonhui/agentbridge/mcp";
const mcp = new McpManager();
agent.attachMcp(mcp);
await mcp.add({ id: "fs", transport: "stdio", command: "node", args: ["./fs-mcp.js", "/dir"],
                watch: { enabled: true } });   // hot reload on file change, ~150ms
```
- Transports: `stdio`, `sse`, `streamable-http`. Tool ids: `mcp:<server>:<name>`.
- Sessions opt in per server: `sessions.create({ mcp: ["fs"] })`.
- Host can call directly: `agent.tools.call(toolId, args, { sessionId? })` → `{ ok, content?, error? }`
  (a permission denial is `ok:false` with `error.code: "AB-4001"`, not a throw).
- Permission classes are inferred: annotations > overrides > name heuristics > WRITE default.

## Permissions (deny-by-default)

```typescript
import { PermissionManager } from "@jeonhui/agentbridge/permission";
const permissions = new PermissionManager({ promptHook: { enabled: true } }); // hook: CLI agents' own calls stop and ask too
agent.attachPermissions(permissions);
agent.on("permission_request", (e) => {
  // decide, then ONE of:
  agent.permissions.approve(e.requestId, { remember: "session" });
  agent.permissions.deny(e.requestId, { reason: "..." });
});
permissions.setRule({ id: "ok-writes", match: { toolPattern: "mcp:fs:*", pathScope: "/workspace/**" },
                      effect: "allow", priority: 10, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
permissions.autoApprove(true);   // approve everything (dev only)
```
No answer within `approvalTimeoutMs` (default 120s) = deny. API providers get `ask` natively;
CLI agents need the `promptHook`. Questions ALWAYS surface to the host app — AgentBridge never
renders its own prompt.

## Agent definitions & agent-calls-agent

```typescript
agent.agents.define({ id: "reviewer", name: "Code Reviewer", description: "Reviews diffs.",
  role: "You are a strict reviewer.", provider: "anthropic", model: "claude-sonnet-4-5",
  mcp: ["fs"], memory: "oneshot"|"persistent", callable: true });
await agent.sessions.create({ agent: "reviewer" });          // definition + overrides
await agent.tools.call("agent:reviewer:ask", { message: "review src/auth.ts" });
// -> { ok, content: { agent, sessionId, reply } }
```
Every callable definition is also a tool (`ask_<id>`) that other agents can call — through the
same permission system (class EXECUTE). Chains are capped by `maxAgentCallDepth` (default 2,
AB-1009 beyond). `memory: "persistent"` keeps one remembering session per definition.

## Config (all optional)

```typescript
new AgentBridge({ dataDir: "~/.agentbridge", logLevel: "warn", defaultPermissionMode: "ask",
  approvalTimeoutMs: 120000, eventRetentionPerSession: 1000, workingDirectory: process.cwd(),
  maxAgentCallDepth: 2, storage: new FileStorage({ dataDir }), logger, secrets });
```
Default storage is in-memory; use `FileStorage` (from the core export) to survive restarts
(sessions, MCP registrations, permission rules, usage totals all restore). `secret://<key>`
references in env/config resolve through the `secrets` resolver; unresolved = AB-6004 error.

## SDK (same code, both transports) & REST

```typescript
import { createClient } from "@jeonhui/agentbridge/sdk";
const client = createClient({ transport: "embedded", agent });
const client = createClient({ transport: "http", baseUrl, token, webSocket: (u) => new WebSocket(u) });
```
`/sdk` imports nothing from Node — it bundles for browsers (~13 kB).

REST (Bearer token, loopback only): `GET /health`, `GET/POST /providers(/detect)`,
`GET/POST /sessions`, `GET/DELETE /sessions/:id`, `POST /sessions/:id/messages` (`{message, attachments?}`, 202),
`/interrupt`, `/resume`, `PATCH /sessions/:id/{mcp,model,permission-mode}`, `GET /sessions/:id/events?sinceSeq=`,
`GET/POST /mcp`, `GET/DELETE /mcp/:id`, `POST /mcp/:id/{connect,disconnect,reload}`,
`GET/POST /agents`, `GET/DELETE /agents/:id`, `GET /tools(/:id)`, `POST /tools/:id/call`,
`GET /permissions/pending`, `POST /permissions/:requestId/{approve,deny}`, `GET/PUT /permissions/policies`.
Events stream over `ws://host:port/events?token=...` — send
`{ "t": "subscribe", "sessionIds"?: [...], "events"?: [...], "sinceSeq"?: n }` as a JSON frame;
`sinceSeq` replays retained events to close a reconnect gap (outside retention = AB-5003).

## Errors

`AgentBridgeError` with codes `AB-1xxx` provider (1001 unknown, 1002 unavailable, 1005 capability
unsupported, 1006 upstream/process failure, 1008 unknown agent definition, 1009 agent depth),
`AB-2xxx` MCP/tools (2201 tool not found, 2202 execution failed, 2203 bad input), `AB-3xxx`
sessions (3002 wrong state, 3003 busy without queueing, 3004 not found), `AB-4xxx` permissions
(4001 denied, 4003 approval timeout), `AB-5xxx` runtime/auth, `AB-6xxx` secrets. Every error
carries `{ code, message, retryable, details? }`.

## Gotchas for generated code

- ESM only; Node >= 20. No default export — use named imports from the subpaths above.
- Register providers BEFORE `agent.start()`; attach `McpManager`/`PermissionManager` before too.
- `send()` awaits the whole turn. For streaming UX, subscribe to `message` events and treat
  `delta:true` as append, `delta:false` as the authoritative full text.
- Without a `PermissionManager`, tool calls run UNCHECKED; with one, default mode is `ask` and an
  unanswered ask is a deny.
- The daemon binds 127.0.0.1 and mints a new token each start (written to `~/.agentbridge/runtime.json`).
- Full spec: `docs/AgentBridge-Product-Spec.md` in the repository
  (https://github.com/Jeonhui/agent-bridge).
